module_role: All published typed M7.01–M7.03 source-matrix scopes and ownership limits.

applications.ownership_scope: Published AHU-6 M7.01 point-matrix scope; physical devices, controller/card/terminal mapping and field wiring are not stated.
Published supply-VAV-terminal M7.02 matrix scope; this is not a per-box physical expansion or controller binding.
Published M7.02 exhaust-fan matrix scope; final fan/device multiplicity and wiring are not stated.
Published P-12/P-13 M7.02 matrix scope; no final controller/terminal/device assignment is stated.
Published M7.03 suspended-unit-heater matrix scope; it is not a physical component/terminal count.

expanded_count_warning: 100 is the count of literal source-matrix rows, including printed section labels where shown. It is not a count of installed sensors, actuators, controllers, I/O cards, terminals, wires, BACnet objects or field devices.
